summary: The current ApplySubstitutions implementation advances the source position by only about half the matched pattern length, leaving matched characters available for later substitutions and appending leftover fragments. This accounts for the overlapping, residual-text, and incorrect-count failures across the in-place and returned-string overloads.
hypotheses: ApplySubstitutions advances pos by (sub.old.size() + 1) / 2 instead of past the full matched pattern, causing already-consumed source text to be reconsidered.
